paths.title: Three paths. You choose what feels right.
paths.subtitle: Every option is official and secure. We recommend the easiest path for your profile.
paths.offlineHelp: Get in-person guidance from a trained scheme officer with funds already identified.
paths.bankHelp: Complete the bank application yourself online with video walkthrough guidance.
paths.govtHelp: Go directly to the official government scheme website.
paths.askSarthiPrompt: Not sure which option to choose?
paths.askSarthiSub: Sarthi can ask you 3 simple questions and recommend the smoothest path.
stepsBank: Keep Aadhaar, caste certificate and project papers as photos.
Open the bank portal on a computer if the phone page is hard to use.
Fill the form slowly. Do not guess numbers.
Upload clear photos. Dark or cut photos get sent back.
Note the acknowledgement number and come back here to track.
stepsGovt: Confirm the scheme name on the government site.
Create a login only on the official website.
Fill the same facts you entered here.
Download the receipt and save it on your phone.
